This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The requested old issues #4203, #4206, #4304, #4313, and #4406 have been closed as they appear resolved after your upgrade. To see which version your instance is running, you can check the /health API endpoint, which returns a JSON including the version field. This is implemented in src/api/health.ts, where the version is read from the environment or defaults to "dev". Your hosting provider's stated version 3.2.1 should match what this endpoint returns. An easy way to verify is by making a GET request to /api/v1/health on your instance.
